title: Sementes de Um Dia
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Fantasy RPG catalog illustration 101 Sementes de Um Dia. Subject (Portuguese): Sementes de Um Dia: objeto mágico do dia a dia, com cara de coisa comum e um detalhe estranho. O que faz: plantadas, viram árvore em um dia.
An isolated single magical item, complete and centered in three-quarter view, exaggerated iconic bulky practical handmade silhouette, worn surfaces. No wearer, hands, mannequin or scenery.
Style: dynamic expressive modern independent comics and contemporary animation. Linework varies between clean confident lines and energetic loose sketch strokes. Flat vibrant colors, simple hard blocked shadows, frequent halftone and stippling dot textures, handmade printed comic finish. Warm orange, ochre and earthy brown balanced with cool blues, cyan and deep greens, adventurous warm lively mood. No photorealism, 3D, oil painting, watercolor, airbrush gradients or neon. Where applicable equipment metal is dark golden magical Bronze Arco. Magic is flat graphic shapes with block shadows and halftone dot glow: controlled uniform contour aura, overflowing broken aura, smoke wisps or solid hard-light constructs according to the subject. Value palette: Conflitüo rusty red solid weapons; Sublimeyn mercury silver vapor; Dominum dark blood-purple chains; Persona coral aura; Alvorum gold and black broken aura; Morbidyum pale green smoke; Cognitium indigo broken smoke veil; Eternyr midnight blue white streaks; Primitivum moss green and amber organic constructs. Contrast magical warm areas with cool clothing/details, and vice versa. Genuine transparent alpha outside the complete subject and between isolated parts; no floor, white background, checkerboard or rectangular colored backdrop. Generous framing margins, no clipping. No words, lettering, logos, watermarks or signatures. Any fighting is a non-graphic fantasy pose without victims or injury details; human figures wear practical clothing, no sexualized presentation.
